counting: Five distinct reviewer records across two runs. Payment and SPARQL records overlap earlier findings; do not add these to the estate distinct-issue count without reconciliation.

records.title: [HIGH] Git clone exposes private child resources with only pod-root Read
records.disposition: Source confirms root Read gates whole upload-pack. Feature git is default-off and enabled by forge. Exact deployed build and a child/history runtime repro remain unverified. This path predates the repair.
records.acceptance: Test Git clone/fetch against private children and historical versions with permitted and denied callers; define authority for whole-repository disclosure and enforce it. Verify git/forge feature exposure in each consumer.

records.title: [HIGH_BUG] Web-Ledger fee debited before the request is validated or served
records.disposition: Admission-before-effect debit ordering predates the repair. The claim that a sidecar Control gate itself charges is overstated: elevated Control explicitly skips consumption. POST may still charge container admission before refusal; delivery atomicity remains open.
records.acceptance: Test admission refusal, validation failure, storage failure, retry and successful delivery against ledger state; specify charging semantics and avoid duplicate or unintended debit across those outcomes.

records.title: [MEDIUM] Proxy forwards X-Upstream-Authorization across cross-origin and HTTPS->HTTP redirects
records.disposition: Source confirms original request header reused on every manual redirect. No fresh network redirect credential fixture was run; path predates the repair.
records.acceptance: Test same-origin, cross-origin and HTTPS-to-HTTP redirects with a sentinel upstream credential; constrain forwarding to its authorised origin and retain per-hop destination checks.

records.title: [MEDIUM] /.well-known/apps publishes per-pod manifest.json bypassing WAC
records.disposition: Source confirms direct filesystem manifest read with no WAC check. No fresh HTTP manifest fixture was run; path predates the repair.
records.acceptance: Test anonymous app discovery with public and private manifests; route publication through the documented access decision and keep permitted discovery working.

records.title: SPARQL DELETE/INSERT ignores WHERE and skips variable templates
records.disposition: Source at base fe4f2ec and repair daff10d destructures DeleteInsert with delete, insert, .., drops WHERE and applies ground templates. No fresh runtime repro in this checkpoint. Variable-template no-op overlaps imported SP-PAR-SPARQL-NOOP; conditional ground mutation is an additional acceptance case, not five new findings.
records.acceptance: Test unmatched and matched WHERE with ground and variable templates through the real PATCH route; implement supported semantics or reject unsupported updates without mutating stored triples.
